# Pegasus — logistics operating system

> Pegasus is the logistics operating system for supplier-led networks. It unifies dispatch, fleet tracking, payments, and realtime coordination across six roles in one governed state machine.

Languages: English (default) and Russian via `?lang=en` / `?lang=ru`.

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://pegasus.io/): Platform overview — order lifecycle, dispatch, fleet, and role apps.
- [Solutions](https://pegasus.io/solutions): Use cases by supplier, warehouse, retailer, finance, driver, factory, and gate.
- [Roles](https://pegasus.io/roles): Feature map by business role.
- [Platform](https://pegasus.io/platform): Core platform topics — order lifecycle, control plane, payments.
- [Request Demo](https://pegasus.io/join): Book a live walkthrough of the Pegasus control plane.
- [Contact](https://pegasus.io/contact): Sales and deployment questions.

## Client surfaces

- [Desktop apps](https://pegasus.io/desktop-apps): Desktop clients for retailer, supplier, warehouse, and factory.
- [Web apps](https://pegasus.io/web-apps): Browser portals for operations teams.
- [Mobile apps](https://pegasus.io/mobile-apps): Native Android and iOS apps per role.

## What Pegasus does

Pegasus unifies supplier-led logistics in one governed state machine: orders are vetted, loaded, sealed, tracked in transit, reconciled at payment, and completed with audit trails across supplier, warehouse, retailer, driver, factory, and payload gate roles.

## Direct answers

**What is Pegasus?** A logistics operating system for supplier-led networks spanning dispatch, fleet, payments, and six operational roles.

**Who is it for?** Supplier ops, warehouse dispatch, retailers, drivers, factory loading, and gate/returns teams that need one shared order status.

**How do I get a demo?** Submit the form at `/join` or message via `/contact`.
